signature:
theorem radialLevel_hasLaw (n : ℕ+) (h : ℕ) (i : Fin (h + 1))
    (x : Fin (h - i.val + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val)) :
    let P := {p : Fin (2 ^ (64 * (h + 1)) + 1) // Even p.val ∧ 4 ≤ p.val}
    let B := Fin (h + 1) × P
    let C := fun b : B ↦
      ((Fin b.2.val.val × (Σ j : Fin (h - b.1.val + 1),
        Fin ((2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val))) → Fin n.val)
    let degree := fun p : P ↦
      (⟨p.val.val, p.property.1, p.property.2, Nat.le_of_lt_succ p.val.isLt⟩ :
        {p : ℕ // Even p ∧ 4 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (h + 1))})
    let S : ℕ := ∑ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1), (2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val
    let a := fun p : P ↦ 1 / ((p.val.val : ℝ) ^ 4 * (S : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      Real.sqrt ((h - i.val + 1 : ℕ) * Real.log (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * (h + 1)) * S)))
    let χ := fun r : ℝ ↦
      expNegInvGlue (r - 13 / 20) /
        (expNegInvGlue (r - 13 / 20) + expNegInvGlue (7 / 10 - r)) *
      (expNegInvGlue (1 - r) /
        (expNegInvGlue (1 - r) + expNegInvGlue (r - 19 / 20)))
    let c := ∏ j, χ (‖x j‖ / Real.sqrt n.val)
    let F := fun (u : Fin (h - i.val + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val))
        (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Σ b : B, C b)) ↦ ∑ p : P,
      angularDegreeComponent n h i (degree p) u
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun c : C (i, p) ↦ ξ ⟨(i, p), c⟩))
    let H := fun ξ ↦ if ∃ j, x j = 0 then 0
      else c * F (fun j ↦ NormedSpace.normalize (x j)) ξ
    HasLaw H (gaussianReal 0 (((n.val : ℝ) * c ^ 2 * ∑ p : P, (a p) ^ 2).toNNReal))
      (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Σ b : B, C b)))

TYPING: n positive, h natural, i within levels 0..h. x contains exactly the trailing spatial blocks x_i,…,x_h; preceding blocks are not arguments of H_i.
Full unconditioned ordered coefficient carrier and exact allowed degree subtype as in the checked angular law.
STANDING: The paper takes large n and a prescribed h(n); this isolated one-point identity is valid for all positive n and natural h, without extending hard-family admissibility.
derived_not_assumed: Unit normalized directions on the nonzero branch; C_i=0 if one trailing block is zero; measurability of H_i as a function of coefficients at this fixed location; exact Gaussian law, including variance zero.

definition_audit.body: No new public definition. The local χ is the literal product of the two unscaled expNegInvGlue = rho quotients in footnote 2 with exact rational breakpoints; replacing each by a rescaled smoothTransition would change the exponent and is not done. The local c is Eq. (16), the product at ‖x_j‖/sqrt(n). The local F is exactly Eq. (15). H is zero if a participating block is zero, else c times F evaluated at the normalized trailing blocks. For nonzero inputs Mathlib normalize is division by the norm, not random normalization.
